el.Pinto hace más de veinte años. Empecé es: I've been painting for more than twenty years. I started out studying systems engineering, but my passion was art: I took workshops with renowned artists and I haven't stopped since.
el.Mi trabajo es una búsqueda constante: ex: My work is a constant search: to express my inner self through painting. Color is the voice I use to speak without words. Materials don't limit me, which is why almost all my works are mixed media.

el.Una serie que tuvo muchísimas obras y es: A series that grew to include many works and is a central part of my journey. A few are still available: they're perfect for starting a collection, building a composition on a wall, or giving art as a gift.
